privacy.intro: Salam Cab ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us when you book a taxi, transfer, or Umrah transport service through our website.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you make a booking, we collect information such as your full name, phone number, email address, flight number, pick-up and drop-off locations, and payment preference. We also collect basic usage data (such as pages visited) to improve our website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to confirm and manage your booking, send booking confirmations and updates by email or WhatsApp, assign a driver, provide customer support, and improve our services.

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We only share your booking details with the driver assigned to your trip and, where required, with payment or communication providers who help us operate our service. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Access to booking data is limited to authorized Salam Cab staff.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us using the details below.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: Our website may use essential cookies to remember your language preference and keep the booking process working smoothly. We do not use cookies for third-party advertising.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please reach out to us via WhatsApp, phone, or email using the contact details on our Contact page.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of Salam Cab's website and booking of our private taxi, Umrah, and airport transfer services across Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah. By booking with us, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: Booking & Confirmation
sections.body: A booking is confirmed once you complete the verification step and receive a booking reference. Prices are calculated based on the route, vehicle type, date, and any applicable surcharges shown at the time of booking.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payment is collected in cash directly from the driver upon arrival, unless otherwise agreed in writing. No advance online payment is required to confirm a booking.

sections.title: Cancellations & Changes
sections.body: You may request to cancel or change your booking by contacting us via WhatsApp or phone. Please refer to our Refund Policy for details on cancellation timelines.

sections.title: Vehicle & Driver Standards
sections.body: All vehicles are maintained to a high standard of cleanliness and safety, and all drivers are licensed and experienced in serving pilgrims and travelers across Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: Passenger Responsibilities
sections.body: Passengers are responsible for providing accurate pick-up details, flight numbers, and passenger counts, and for being ready at the agreed pick-up time and location.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Salam Cab is not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including traffic, weather, or force majeure events. We will make every reasonable effort to notify you of any changes.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions periodically. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

refund.intro: We understand travel plans can change. This Refund Policy explains how cancellations and refunds are handled for bookings made through Salam Cab.

sections.title: Cancellation Window
sections.body: Bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the scheduled pick-up time are eligible for a full refund or free rescheduling, where an advance payment has been made.

sections.title: Late Cancellations
sections.body: Cancellations made less than 24 hours before pick-up, or no-shows, may not be eligible for a refund, as a vehicle and driver have already been allocated to your trip.

sections.title: Cash on Arrival Bookings
sections.body: As most bookings are paid in cash on arrival, no advance payment is typically collected. In this case, cancelling simply releases your reserved vehicle with no charge.

sections.title: How to Request a Refund or Change
sections.body: To cancel, reschedule, or request a refund for an advance payment, please contact us via WhatsApp or phone with your booking reference as soon as possible.

sections.title: Processing Time
sections.body: Approved refunds for advance payments are processed within 5–7 business days back to the original payment method.

sections.title: Contact for Refund Requests
sections.body: For any refund or cancellation request, reach our support team via WhatsApp, phone, or email listed on our Contact page — we're available 24/7.
